messages:
emma: Heads-up: our recent change to the package export map in js-sdk is breaking onboarding for the nextjs starter when run with Vite/Bun. Repro steps in thread.

emma: Repro:
1) npx degit redwood/example-nextjs starter && cd starter
2) yarn && yarn dev (vite)
3) open localhost -> app fails to load, console shows resolver error

emma: Pushed exports snippet:
```json
{"name":"@redwood/js-sdk","exports":{".":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.js"},"./*":"./dist/*"},"types":"./dist/index.d.ts"}
```

emma: Vite error: "Failed to resolve entry for package \"@redwood/js-sdk\". The package may have incorrect \"exports\" or \"module\" field."

raj: Wildcard exports can be flaky across bundlers. Vite and Bun don't always expand "./*" -> "./dist/*" the same way Node does. Also .mjs entries sometimes confuse older toolchains.

dina: Short fix: revert the wildcard and explicitly list public subpaths (e.g. "./client", "./server"). Quick patch will be easiest to unblock users.

ci-bot: CI: examples smoke tests failing on preview because of package resolution.

raj: Long-term: add CI smoke matrix for examples (vite/esbuild/bun/next), include a release check that validates exports vs a whitelist, and publish both .js ESM and .cjs builds.

emma: I'm opening a revert PR now and will publish a patch. Will follow up with an RFC on export surface and a doc for package maintainers.

dina: Thanks — will update starter READMEs with interim deep-import workaround: import from '@redwood/js-sdk/dist/esm/index.js' until patch published.
